FOR THE PARENT'S RULING: capitol.texas.gov's robots file says 'Disallow: /TLODOCS/' (upper case); the reader matched case-sensitively and allowed the lower-case path /tlodocs/ it was given, and the server answered. If the parent reads that rule as covering /tlodocs/, this entry should be dropped or re-read from another official copy. The PUCT's implementing rules (Project No. 58000 proposal, held in large_load_connection_rules/puct_project_58000_proposal.yaml; 16 TAC 25.194, Project No. 58481) were not read here.
